name: Buy In 3
definition: Specifies elements related to the response sent by the clearing member to the central counterparty in the context of the buy in process.

BuyInNotificationIdentification.name: Buy In Notification Identification
BuyInNotificationIdentification.definition: Indicates the reference of the BuyInNotification message.

RequestForDelayIndicator.name: Request For Delay Indicator
RequestForDelayIndicator.definition: Specific continuous net settlement case where the central counterparty can call for buy-in at a date anterior to "theoretical" buy-in date, the clearing member may request a delay.

NumberOfDays.name: Number Of Days
NumberOfDays.definition: Number of days associated to the request for delay.

InitialQuantity.name: Initial Quantity
InitialQuantity.definition: Buy in quantity called initially by the central counterparty.

CoveredQuantity.name: Covered Quantity
CoveredQuantity.definition: Quantity amount covered by the clearing member after notification.

UncoveredQuantity.name: Uncovered Quantity
UncoveredQuantity.definition: Quantity amount non covered by the clearing member after notification (this is, new buy in amount to be executed).
